$comment: Hand-curated. Merged into PAGE_MAP.md by scripts/gen-page-map.mjs as the 'what it is' column. Keys are '<app>:<url>' exactly as the generator derives them; the generator FAILS when a route has no entry here or an entry names a route that no longer exists, so this file cannot rot. Write one line per route: what a person sees / what the endpoint decides, in plain words, with the Indonesian menu label in quotes so a grep on either language finds it.

routes.admin:/: Dashboard Seller — today's sales, orders, KPIs and the 7/30-day chart, all derived live from `orders` (never `analytics_daily`).
routes.admin:/affiliate: 'Affiliate' (under Promo) — store affiliate programme: commissions with 'Tandai dibayar', affiliates (approve/reject/deactivate/add), programme settings and per-product rates (Task 9.4, `specs/AFFILIATE_SPEC.md`).
routes.admin:/akun/langganan: 'Langganan' — the store's plan, trial/period countdown, payment history, link to the printable faktur.
routes.admin:/analitik: 'Analitik' — sales, funnel, devices, products; every figure from `orders`/`analytics_events`, '—' when there is no source.
routes.admin:/bantuan: 'Bantuan' — the merchant's support tickets list (writes go to the Super Admin ticket desk).
routes.admin:/crm: 'CRM' landing — redirects/overview of pipeline, follow-ups, templates.
routes.admin:/crm/template: 'Template' — WhatsApp message templates used by CRM and abandoned-cart recovery.
routes.admin:/diskon: 'Diskon' (vouchers) — list; status shown from `nonaktif` + dates, never dates alone.
routes.admin:/diskon/[id]: Voucher editor — a blank period = no end date; an edit never moves `starts_at`.
routes.admin:/flash-sale: 'Flash Sale' — list with live/upcoming badge computed on the server clock.
routes.admin:/flash-sale/[id]: Flash sale editor — price reaches variant rows, not only the headline.
routes.admin:/keuangan: 'Keuangan' — the seller's money overview (entitlement = goods + goods PPN − shipping debits).
routes.admin:/keuangan/penghasilan: 'Penghasilan' — per-order earnings breakdown (fees, PPN, shipping delta).
routes.admin:/navigasi: 'Navigasi' — storefront menus; Simpan = delete + re-insert the tree.
routes.admin:/obrolan: 'Obrolan' — the storefront chat inbox (WhatsApp-style, per store).
routes.admin:/pelanggan: 'Pelanggan' — customers list; guests (`registered_at IS NULL`) are the normal case.
routes.admin:/pelanggan/keranjang: 'Keranjang ditinggal' — abandoned checkouts; recovery over WhatsApp ('WA dibuka', never 'terkirim'); rate = rescued/abandoned only.
routes.admin:/pemasaran: 'Pemasaran' — ad channels (Meta/Google/TikTok) connection, catalog id scheme, conversion queue health; 'dari pesanan toko Anda', never 'menurut Meta'.
routes.admin:/pengaturan: 'Pengaturan' — store profile, pickup address ('Alamat': kecamatan + kelurahan → the courier's ids), shipping ('Pengiriman'/'Jasa Kirim' per service, COD opt-in), domains, users/roles. Payment channels are NOT here (platform decision).
routes.admin:/pesanan: 'Pesanan' — orders list with status tabs; URL params validated before any enum cast.
routes.admin:/pesanan/[id]: Order detail — status actions (one writer: `applyOrderStatusChange`), 'Cek Ongkir' → book any service with the cost delta reconciled to the seller ledger, label, tracking.
routes.admin:/pesanan/massal: 'Pesanan massal' — bulk booking with the service the shopper paid for, bulk labels, 'sudah/belum dicetak'.
routes.admin:/produk/[id]: Product editor — variants grid, media (upload/drag), dimensions (they price ongkir), taxonomy.
routes.admin:/produk/pembelian: 'Pembelian' — purchase orders: build lines, 'Terima barang' adds stock, cancel = delete.
routes.admin:/promo: 'Promo' hub — vouchers, flash sales and landing pages in one place.
routes.admin:/promo/html/baru: New landing HTML (`/lp/<slug>`) — raw markup EXECUTES on the shop origin; `landing:html` is owner-only.
routes.admin:/promo/html/[id]: Landing HTML editor (same owner-only rule for the markup).
routes.admin:/saldo: 'Saldo' — pending/available balance derived from the ledger, payout requests (never joins `orders` when summing).
routes.admin:/tema/[id]: Puck editor for one template; palette is per template type.
routes.admin:/daftar: Self-serve store sign-up → review queue in Super Admin.
routes.admin:/faktur/[number]: Printable subscription invoice (renders the STORED tax).
routes.admin:/login: Seller login (rate-limited per IP + per account; no published credentials).
routes.admin:/api/admin/labels: Renders 100×150 mm shipping labels (Code 128) for orders that already have a real AWB; prints the courier's sorting code above the barcode (always drawn for SPX/ID Express/J&T/J&T Cargo) and returns `missingSortingCode`.
routes.admin:/api/auth/signout: Deletes the session cookie (a Server Component cannot).
routes.admin:/api/cron/billing: Daily billing sweep: trial/period status, renewal invoices, suspension for non-payment (honours `comped`, never `stores.status`).
routes.admin:/api/cron/order-expiry: Expires unpaid prepaid orders after their window.
routes.admin:/api/cron/payment-advice: Every 15 min asks the PSP's advice endpoint for each live bill — observe only, settles nothing.
routes.admin:/api/cron/tracking: Every 15 min pulls KiriminAja tracking for booked orders (`parseKaTracking`: `details` + package `status_code`): fills a REAL `orders.awb` (never `MOCK-<ref>`), the sorting code, and advances status forward-only.
routes.admin:/api/cron/tracking-events: Every 60 s delivers queued conversions (Meta CAPI / GA4 / TikTok) with retries + dead-letter.
routes.admin:/api/health/env: Reports which integrations are configured (header-gated), used by the deploy probe.
routes.admin:/api/public/kiriminaja/webhook: Courier webhook receiver — hint only; fails closed on the Bearer; the tracking pull is the truth. A `processed_packages` row's sorting code is kept only when its awb equals the verified waybill.
routes.admin:/api/public/ongkir: Storefront quote: area search + live rates from the seller's pickup district over the seller's catalogue weight/box; effective COD flag per rate.
routes.admin:/api/public/order: THE order boundary: re-normalises every field, re-quotes shipping, prices from `product_variants`, enforces voucher/COD, writes the order + payment.
routes.admin:/api/public/pay/callback: PSP payment callback — signed per-payment `?cb=`, exactly one identity, credits the ledger on `berhasil`.
routes.admin:/api/public/promo: Voucher check for the checkout (deliberately specific error copy).
routes.admin:/impersonate: One-time exchange of an opaque grant → 30-minute merchant session for a Super Admin operator.
routes.admin:/impersonate/exit: Ends an impersonation session and logs it.
routes.super-admin:/: Platform dashboard (MRR, revenue, merchant float, latest invoices) — `admin` rank; support is forwarded to its landing.
routes.super-admin:/analitik: Platform analytics + cron liveness cards (billing, tracking, conversions, payment advice).
routes.super-admin:/log-sistem: 'Log Sistem' — the whole `platform_activity` audit log, filtered and paged in the database.
routes.super-admin:/paket: 'Paket' — the single plan's prices/trial (legacy tiers unused).
routes.super-admin:/pencairan: 'Pencairan' — seller payout queue; complete = compare-and-swap `diproses → selesai`.
routes.super-admin:/pengaturan: 'Pengaturan' — payment channels/gateway, couriers + COD policy (SPX only), KiriminAja test/sync + env badge, finance (PPN toggle), operators.
routes.super-admin:/toko: 'Toko' — all stores by lifecycle segment (trial / first month / regular / VIP) + review queue.
routes.super-admin:/toko/[id]: Store detail: billing, users (add/reset — credential shown once), suspend with a reason, comp a month, 'Buka Dashboard Seller'.
routes.super-admin:/update-log: 'Update Log' — the product changelog shown to operators (`dev-logs.ts`), paged.
routes.super-admin:/login: Operator login (front door, rank re-read from `platform_admins` on every request).
routes.storefront:/: Store homepage — the `homepage` template (Store Builder) with hero, sections, pixels deferred to first interaction.
routes.storefront:/produk: Catalogue with server-side sort + pagination ('Daftar Produk').
routes.storefront:/produk/[handle]: Product page — gallery, variant picker, buy box, reviews; `product` template renders the tail.
routes.storefront:/kategori/[handle]: One collection: CategoryHero always, then the `category` template body.
routes.storefront:/promo: Promo hub — live vouchers and flash sales (`nonaktif` + date window).
routes.storefront:/lp/[slug]: Merchant landing page (raw HTML EXECUTES here) with the COD order form.
routes.storefront:/keranjang: Cart (client-side lines; the server prices everything at order time).
routes.storefront:/checkout: Checkout — kecamatan/kelurahan cascade, ongkir via `/api/public/ongkir`, COD gate with a reason, Indonesian validation (`novalidate` is load-bearing), progressive capture to `checkout_sessions`.
routes.storefront:/checkout/sukses: Order success — shows the unpaid VA/QR for prepaid, fires the COD conversion only.
routes.storefront:/affiliate: 'Program Affiliate' — public application form (POST to itself, honeypot, 5/hour/IP); 404 while the store's programme is off (Task 9.5).
routes.storefront:/affiliate/saya: 'Dashboard affiliate' — interim self-view opened by a signed link (?t=, F-A18, Task 9.13): code, share link, totals, commission history; 404 unless the token verifies for this store and the affiliate is aktif; no third-party pixels.
routes.storefront:/404: Not found (also what a wrong Host resolves to).
routes.storefront:/api/checkout-session: Progressive checkout capture (debounced beacons; tenant from Host; fails quiet).
routes.storefront:/api/search: Search index for the palette; returns per-row srcset built on the server.
routes.storefront:/feed/google.xml: Google Merchant product feed (`<g:id>` = `retailerId()` — same id as the pixels).
routes.storefront:/robots.txt: Per-tenant robots (Cloudflare Managed robots.txt sits in front — see the file's note).
routes.landing:/fitur: Every feature in the one plan, grouped (store, sales, shipping, marketing, operations) with real screenshots.
routes.landing:/harga: Subscription pricing (one plan, monthly/annual switch) and the who-pays-which-fee table.
routes.landing:/cara-kerja: Signup → review → setup → first order, the daily workflow, and the subscription billing timeline.
routes.landing:/pembayaran-pengiriman: Payment channels, COD rules, couriers, payout, and the who-pays-which-fee table, all from code constants.
routes.landing:/demo: What to try on the demo storefront (batiknusantara.tokophi.id), with its real screens.

howto: change how ongkir is priced (weight, box, origin)
change what is sent to the courier when booking
`packages/lib/src/billing.ts`; PPN is the global toggle in Super Admin → Pengaturan → Keuangan

`apps/admin/app/(admin)/<route>/page.tsx` + read in `lib/data/<entity>.ts` (inside `withCurrentTenant`) + `lib/nav.ts`; then add its line to `scripts/page-descriptions.json` and run `node scripts/gen-page-map.mjs`
`apps/super-admin/app/(platform)/<route>/page.tsx` with `platformRouteGate(path)` as its FIRST await + classify it in `lib/route-roles.ts`
`lib/actions/<entity>.ts`: `requireCapability(...)` first, then `withTenant(storeId, …)`; child tables with no `store_id` need the parent read back inside the same txn

hand-written idempotent migration in `packages/db/drizzle/` (copy `0109`), journal entry with a stamp ABOVE the newest, `schema.ts`, `npm run verify-migrations -w @tokophi/db`; never `npm run generate`
change the storefront look for every store
`packages/sections` (Store Builder sections) + `apps/storefront/src/components`; a saved template keeps rendering old section types (renderer `default:` is a guard)
`packages/lib/src/validate.ts` (the rule) + `apps/storefront/src/pages/checkout.astro` (the early UX copy); test on an `en-US` browser
`apps/admin/lib/tracking-events.ts` (from the ORDER ROW) + `packages/lib/src/tracking-ids.ts` (catalog id) — both halves of an id flip together
`apps/admin/lib/actions/ledger.ts` + `order-finance.ts`; three partial unique indexes make a double-credit impossible; never join `orders` when summing
change a cron cadence or add one
change the reference areas / postcodes / coordinates
`packages/db/scripts/build-kelurahan.mjs`, `build-ka-kelurahan-ids.mjs`, `build-area-coords.mjs` → the CSVs in `packages/db/data/` (reloaded by `seed-areas.ts` on deploy)
`packages/db/src/seed.ts` — the seed is NOT a migration: an existing store needs an explicit data fix
find why a screen shows a wrong number
